PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
